affects: header width check across 7 views × 6 widths

branches.resolution: Rebuilt the panel as a native <dialog> opened with showModal(), with a capped height and its own scroll

branches.trigger: In dev, React StrictMode ran the effect twice, so the first run's 'seen' mark skipped the animation
branches.resolution: Mark the animation as seen only once it has typed to the end

branches.trigger: You wanted no full stops and more space between the lines
branches.resolution: Dropped the full stops and spaced the lines out; screen readers get a list; the meta description adds the full stops back

branches.trigger: Greptile 4/5: number keys opened links behind the help panel, and held keys repeated

branches.trigger: You wanted letter keys (e for email…), but e already meant Experience

branches.trigger: Greptile: with help open or the key held, e skipped b5's guard and went to Experience

conflicts.what: b5's early return happened before the key was marked handled, so once b6 made e a contact key, it fell through to Experience; b7 had to reorder it
The node 3 rename (experience → work) removed the e clash that b6's capture-phase override was built for; the override stayed as a general guard with rewritten comments
Undid the full stops in the msg-2 wording (node 5), so the meta description had to add them back with a '. ' join
Each of the two byline rewrites undid the byline merged just before it (#35, then #41)
Undid the 'most-watched' wording that #32 had already merged
b17 threw out the candle modes built in response to msg 11; b19 then shelved everything b18 had built and fixed
Went against the literal '//' in msg 11; unclear whether that matches what you meant

lost_detail.detail: Because the help panel lives in the browser's top layer, the crosshair had to detect an open modal and hand back the system pointer, or the pointer would vanish under the panel
The guard returned before marking the key as handled; harmless with number keys, but it caused b7 once e became a contact key
The header now skips any key a page has already handled, so Talk's letters still win after the rename
The animation plays once per tab (sessionStorage 'hero-typed', set only on completion), so the demo needed a [replay typing] button to clear it
Diagnosis: the ticker was updating (60 s poll, mostly daily data); the green existed only on unmerged #33, so it appeared live only after the msg-9 merge
The plan was to recheck the live site after #31 merged; it came back clean and the cause was never found
The key for 'more' was listed as an open question in every reply from msg 9 to msg 15 and never answered
Treating one specific design project as the year 1 project, and the missing paper link, were flagged for you to check; still unconfirmed
